name: scopweb/flourish-lib
description: A collection of classes for general web development, with a particular focus on compatibility, portability and security. Modernized for PHP 8.5.

suggest.ext-mbstring: Required by fUTF8 for the fastest multibyte string handling
suggest.ext-pdo_sqlite: Required to use fDatabase with SQLite
suggest.ext-pdo_mysql: Required to use fDatabase with MySQL through PDO
suggest.ext-mysqli: Required to use fDatabase with MySQL through MySQLi
